dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 12 Special Land Use Policy Areas identify locations where site-specific or area-specific land use policies apply in addition to the broader policies of Brampton Plan. These areas address unique planning circumstances, development considerations, or land use requirements that warrant additional policy direction.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
dct_title_s: Brampton Plan-Schedule 12-Special Land Use Policy Areas
